feature_contract.goal: Repair the complete Quest3 title/main menu optical undersize in R84 without stretching captured source artwork, clipping full-width car selection, or altering stereo gameplay/UI.
feature_contract.scope_boundary: Only DX9Ex R84 title and main menu state-dependent optical coverage after game capture; untouched world, camera, F11, ESC, HUD, DX11, DXVK, original game content.
trace_stages: Original game TITLE/MENU/SELECTOR game state published via SharedPose client state.
R23 host captures source pixels/UV/aspect and resolves optical coverage from exact game state before binocular placement.
Host common left/right OpenXR tangent FOV intersection uniformly fits both axes, preserving original physical image aspect.
subcomponents: R23 state-owned title/main default coverage with unchanged selector rollback and exact explicit environment override.
Executable host C++ regression for title/menu/selector/unknown/invalid values, plus the unchanged common FOV and crop safety tests.

acceptance_items.behavior_area: Native main menu capture and stereo optical presentation
acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Exact TITLE 0x04 and MENU 0x09 default to full safe binocular optical rect instead of 0.78 inset without changing image UV or aspect.

acceptance_items.behavior_area: Full-width vehicle select, unknown states, invalid and explicit overrides
acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Selector, exit, reset and unknown states retain 0.78; valid user overrides win, malformed ones safely fallback per state.

acceptance_items.behavior_area: Native Windows x86 game, x64 host, packaging and required CI
acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Committed integrated exact SHA passes required Windows DX9Ex Active, Domain, HUD Inspector and Full Source checks; Quest3 visual validation separate.

diagnosis.original_evidence: Latest Quest3 report 2026-10-17: R84 main menu has correct proportions but appears about 75% of desired display size.
source_trace: SharedPose publishes canonical game-state values TITLE 0x04 and MENU 0x09.
R23 full-client menu capture uses native source UV and aspect before optical presentation.
ResolveMenuOpticalCoverage originally selected 0.78 uniformly, and PlanOpticallyCenteredClip scales both eyes by that amount.
diagnosis.root_cause: A single 0.78 optical default originally calibrated for a full-width selection screen also shrinks correctly proportioned title and main menu states.
alternatives_rejected: Source UV crop or anisotropic scaling risks hiding Ferrari list/art and reintroducing widescreen distortion.
diagnosis.fix_evidence: Bounded per-state default policy and R23 call-site, integrated into existing executable Windows host regression suite.
diagnosis.eye_ownership: Single shared common-FOV optical quad for both eyes, no eye-specific camera or stereo-world mutation.
diagnosis.evidence_limit: No Quest3 runtime executed; candidate source not yet confirmed by CI.

validation_evidence.changed_area_test: outrun-vr-menu-content-aspect-smoke in mandatory x64 host post-build

next_action: Check candidate exact-sha smoke/CI, safely fast-forward after behind=0 with expected_sha and force=false, then final exact-sha target workflows and C6. No HMD test.
